items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Lucky was on the main bandstand, we were on that side... I remember playing a blues... Lucky finally sat in with these guys.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, still is. And so, Lucky sent this telgram, we're going to send you hicks back to the sticks. Not a telegram, it was one of those one-cent postcards. And so --
